scope: RP1 SYS/AUDIO PLLs and clocks needed by selected Ethernet/SD firmware assignments; native compile and mocked-register callbacks only.

references.role: ISC-licensed register/math adaptation, with original license and copyrights retained.
Independent comparison of source-selector, divider-width, fractional-modulator and hardware-clock semantics; no GPL code copied.

validation.native_flags: Original bsd.kmod.mk, -Werror, FDT/INTRNG headers; no install/load.
validation.production_callbacks: Clang18/GCC ASan/UBSan pass for selected13 assigned rates, parent graph, unconfigured descendants, Ethernet125/25/2.5MHz rates, PLL fractional mode/rounding, unchangedPLL and contiguous feedback write batch, reservedbits, dryrun, invalidspecifiers, readback failures/timeout and unavailableprovider lookup.

limitations: Supported IDs0,1,3,4,6,8,9,10,12,13,16,29,31,32 only; no RP1 video/GP/UART/PWM or alternate pinmux claim.
SYS/AUDIO VCO requests bounded to2GHz and validated against supported reference frequency; assigned-rate readback tolerance bounded to one24bit feedback LSB.
Unconfigured/unavailable clocks recalculate as zeroHz to respect the framework descendant-cache contract; provider lookup stays unavailable until required assignments verify.
Clock domains retain resources for boot lifetime because no clkdom/clknode unregister API exists, including partial setup failures.
No physical PLL lock, waveform, clock switching or Ethernet/SD operation demonstrated. Cadence MAC integration and all-Pi hardware acceptance remain open.
Earlier full GENERIC success at75b4c91671e did not include this clock driver.
